review_evidence: Reviewed the 123-file Carleson snapshot and project verification documentation.

The repository contains a completed Lean proof of generalized Carleson theorems, including classical, metric-space, and linearized metric-space Carleson results and their supporting harmonic analysis.
The primary sources are core mathematical definitions and proofs; no lossless exclusion is warranted.
summary: Retain carleson in full as the formalized proof of generalized Carleson theorems and supporting harmonic analysis.

review_evidence: Basics.lean: 44 declarations, including theorem measure_comap_eq_subtype_coe, lemma NoAtoms'.subtype, theorem exists_measurable_between, noncomputable def PFun.ofGraph' and PFun graph lemmas, all with proofs.

Metric.lean: lemma NoAtoms'.of_metric (a proper pseudometric space measure with equal closed and open ball measures has no atoms) with a full tactic proof, plus NoAtoms' instances for Haar-type measures on normed spaces and for volume on unitInterval.

Prod.lean: 29 declarations, including defs essProjFst and essProjSnd (essential projections of subsets of a product) and theorems essProjFst_subset, essProjFst_eq, essProjFst_times_univ, essProjFst_mono with proofs.
summary: Inspected all three NoAtoms files under Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure. Each holds proved Lean declarations about atomless measures (subtype restriction, measurable sets between given sets, partial functions from graphs, metric criteria, product-space essential projections). All stay searchable; no exclusions.

review_evidence: Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpNorm/Misc.lean: Contains 5 lemmas with proofs about eLpNormEssSup congruence, density equivalence, and scaling properties (lines 19-51).

Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/NNReal.lean: Contains 50+ lemmas/theorems and multiple typeclass instances (MeasureSpace, NullSingletonClass, SigmaFinite, IsOpenPosMeasure) with proofs about volumes, measurable embeddings, integral equivalences, and measure-preserving maps (lines 11-685).
summary: Inspected both Lean files in the work unit. Both contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, lemmas, theorems, and instances with proofs related to measure theory on ℝ≥0 and ℝ≥0∞, Lp norms, and integrals. Neither file is a pure import aggregator — each has original declarations and proofs. The previous review of similar Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory files also retained all content.

review_evidence: Carleson/Classical/ControlApproximationEffect.lean: Defines C_distribution_carlesonOperatorReal_le, C_control_approximation_effect, proves distribution_carlesonOperatorReal_le and control_approximation_effect (Lemma 11.6.4).
Carleson/DoublingMeasure.lean: Defines constants D, κ, Z, τ with bounds; proves doubling measure instances, function distances, kernel properties, cancellative properties, volume functions.

Carleson/ForestOperator/PointwiseEstimate.lean: Defines σ, σMax, σMin, 𝓙₀, 𝓙, 𝓛₀, 𝓛, approxOnCube, boundaryOperator, nontangentialMaximalFunction; proves first_tree_pointwise, second_tree_pointwise, third_tree_pointwise.

Carleson/GridStructure.lean: Defines GridStructure class; proves grid manipulation lemmas, successor operations, maximal elements, distance monotonicity (dist_strictMono, dist_mono, dist_strictMono_iterate).
Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/IntervalIntegral/Periodic.lean: Proves setIntegral_Ioc_add_eq, setLIntegral_Ioc_add_eq, eLpNorm for periodic functions, aestronglyMeasurable properties.

Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/MeanInequalities.lean: Proves Minkowski (Lp_add_le_sum), Hölder (lintegral_prod_norm_pow_le'), Cauchy-Schwarz, Young's convolution inequality (eLpNorm_convolution_le_ofReal, eLpNorm_convolution_le_enorm_mul).

Carleson/ToMathlib/RealInterpolation/Main.lean: Defines SubadditiveOn, AESubadditiveOn, SublinearOn, AESublinearOn, PreservesAEStrongMeasurability; proves combine_estimates leading to exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux (Marcinkiewicz theorem).

Carleson/ToMathlib/RealInterpolation/Misc.lean: Defines ScaledPowerFunction, ToneCouple, StrictRangeToneCouple, trunc/truncCompl; proves measurability, Lp properties, integral computations for truncations.
summary: Inspected all 8 Lean files in the work unit. Every file contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs related to measure theory, harmonic analysis (Carleson operators), doubling measures, forest operators, grid structures, periodic integrals, mean inequalities (Minkowski, Hölder, Cauchy-Schwarz, Young's convolution), and real interpolation theory. None are pure import aggregators — each has `@[expose] public section` with original declarations and proofs. The previous review of similar Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory files also retained all content.
